title: The Semester of the water tower
author: Lior Okonkwo
blurb: Isandro Reyes, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent seven years being so careful it hurts. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before prom.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
